name: Rudolftelep (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and black at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Rudolftelep: a blue and black shield with crossed hammers, with a helm, a crest and red, yellow and blue mantling, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Rudolftelep arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
